primitives.name: Synthetic Data Boundary Enforcer
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not import real friend-history data without explicit consent and deletion controls.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: D_real: Real historical dataset (dimensionless), C_explicit: Explicit consent flag (boolean), D_synthetic: Synthetic proxy dataset (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Real social graph data possesses non-zero privacy risk; synthetic proxies maintain structural isomorphism without exposing PII.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if C_explicit is false yet D_real is ingested, causing immediate regulatory singularity.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's conformal prediction sets where out-of-distribution real-world samples are rejected in favor of calibrated synthetic noise.
layer2.telemetry: Zero PII bytes detected in staging environment logs.

primitives.name: Financial State Lock Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not launch paid contests, prizes, deposits, payouts, live leaderboards, sportsbook/DFS affiliate flows, or real-money entries without founder/legal approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: M_real: Real monetary flow (USD), A_legal: Legal authorization vector (boolean array), L_live: Live leaderboard state (boolean)
primitives.assumptions: Any non-zero M_real or active L_live requires a complete match with A_legal to prevent gambling compliance violations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if M_real > 0 and A_legal contains any false elements, triggering an automatic rollback.

layer2.mapping: Acts as a hard constraint kernel in GSE's situational reasoning, vetoing any state transition involving financial vectors unless fully authorized.
layer2.telemetry: Number of blocked financial API calls during dry runs.

primitives.name: Feature Flag Guardian
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Feature flag disabled by default if code is ever approved.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: F_flag: Feature activation switch (boolean), S_default: Default system state (integer = 0)
primitives.assumptions: The safest initial condition for any new engagement primitive is total deactivation (S_default = 0).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks if F_flag defaults to true upon deployment, bypassing the required manual verification phase.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's dirty-state verification, ensuring the shipping clone remains in a clean, predictable baseline before experimental rollout.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of deployments initializing with F_flag = false.

The user agent seeks to exploit any leakage to gain unfair competitive advantages or financial payouts. Our primitives act as a defensive mind-model, anticipating these breaches by enforcing zero-trust architectures where every data packet and state transition is cryptographically verified against the legal and synthetic constraints.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is maintained by ensuring the financial state lock and synthetic boundary enforcer operate on orthogonal subspaces. The veto condition is formally defined as the vanishing of the inner product between the proposed feature vector and the set of all known regulated gambling primitives.
